note: forkPointSha = the upstream commit the fork was created from (v1.39.0 + 1); it never moves. The merge-base moves with every merge and is computed by the script. lastReviewedSha = the last upstream commit reviewed; advance it with .claude/skills/upstream-review/scripts/upstream-review.sh --advance <tip-sha>. Sync is merge-first (see the skill): after a merge the merge-base moves to the upstream tip and lastReviewedSha is an ancestor of HEAD; after a cherry-pick it is not. The driver's range is always lastReviewedSha..careerops/main and it computes the merge-base itself.
